guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 聲程折射耦合盲區與缺陷證據。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Sound paths refraction coupling blind zones and defect evidence. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學單元1的基準量級：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s；y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm
教學單元2的基準量級：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad；y=depth/cos(theta)=70.7107 mm
教學單元3的基準量級：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad；y=depth*sin(theta)/cos(theta)=50 mm
教學單元4的基準量級：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=3230 m/s, f=2500000 Hz；y=c/f*1000=1.292 mm
教學單元5的基準量級：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：A=0.2 1, ref=1 1；y=20*log(A/ref)/log(10)=-13.9794 dB
教學單元6的基準量級：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.02 dB/mm, path=150 mm；y=alpha*path=3 dB

timeline: 2020　日本鐵道總研公布空氣超音波偵測鋼軌開口的研究成果。
2024-03　國際標準組織發布在役鋼軌超音波檢測第一部分。
2026-03-04　美國鐵路管理局發布新版軌道與構造物檢查手冊。
timelineEn: 2020 — RTRI reported research on detecting rail openings using aerial ultrasound.
2024-03 — ISO published Part 1 of its ultrasonic testing standard for installed rails.
2026-03-04 — FRA issued its updated Track and Structures Compliance Manual.
codes: 歐洲基礎設施互通技術規範：依地區與適用版本核對。
ISO 5735-1:2024：在役鋼軌連續超音波檢測範圍，非焊廠生產驗收規範。
codesEn: European Infrastructure TSI: verify jurisdiction and applicable edition.
ISO 5735-1:2024: continuous testing of installed rails, not a production-plant weld acceptance code.
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出軌距與限界、運輸需求、供電與號誌以及施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in gauge and clearance, service demand, power, signalling and construction methods.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：鋼軌超音波探傷
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Ultrasonic rail-flaw detection
guides.concept: 鋼軌超音波探傷以「聲程折射耦合盲區與缺陷證據」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。超音波探傷以聲束與缺陷交互作用取得間接證據，耦合、角度和鋼軌幾何會改變回波；沒有回波不能獨立證明沒有裂紋。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops sound paths refraction coupling blind zones and defect evidence through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Ultrasonic testing obtains indirect evidence from beam-defect interaction; coupling, angle and rail geometry alter echoes, so absence of an echo alone does not prove absence of a crack. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
procedure: 脈衝回波飛行時間包含往返兩程。本模型把 c 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 64.9 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。聲速均勻、垂直往返聲程且零時已扣除；反射體單一。使用已知厚度試塊的回波時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
斜聲束聲程大於垂向深度。本模型把 depth 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 77.7817 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。角度在材料內相對法線定義；只計單程直線聲路。使用折射角與反射體位置作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把聲程直接當深度會錯定位，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

反射體水平位置由聲程方向與深度共同決定。本模型把 depth 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 55 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。材料內直線聲束與平面幾何；正負方向由探頭朝向另定。使用探頭座標及折射角作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
波長影響散射與解析度但不是最小必檢裂紋尺寸。本模型把 c 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.4212 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。聲速與頻率屬同一波型；忽略色散與寬頻效應。使用頻譜中心與材料聲速作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把波長當檢出保證會高估能力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

相同量測鏈下幅值比才可作有意義比較。本模型把 A 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 -13.1515 dB。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩幅值使用相同接收鏈且參考非零；比較振幅而非能量。使用參考反射體與接收增益作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；改變增益卻未記錄會形成假缺陷變化，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
均勻衰減近似中總衰減隨聲程增加。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.3 dB。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。衰減係數固定，聲程為完整傳播總長；不另計幾何擴散。使用不同距離參考反射體作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略材質差異會過度補償雜訊，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
脈衝重複頻率決定沿掃描方向的名義點距。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.75 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。掃描速度與有效脈衝取得率固定；不含漏觸發及聲束寬度。使用速度編碼器與脈衝時序作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；打滑會造成漏掃區段，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

近表面死區是幾何範圍而非缺陷機率。本模型把 dead 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.66667 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。死區與總檢測範圍沿同一方向；比例不是缺陷風險。使用近表面人工反射體作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；未列盲區會把未檢範圍當作已合格，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

背壁回波可協助監測耦合但也受幾何與材質影響。本模型把 back 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.66 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。基準與目前回波使用相同幾何、增益及材質；比例不是單獨耦合真值。使用背壁回波與表面狀況作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；耦合流失會使缺陷與背壁回波同時減弱，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

有已知真值的盲測才能估計樣本漏檢比例。本模型把 misses 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 13.3333 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。所有真缺陷樣本皆列入且判定規則固定；不外推為通用檢出率。使用盲測反射體清單與報告作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只保留成功案例會使績效失真，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
procedureEn: Pulse-echo flight time includes outgoing and returning paths. In this model, c is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 64.9 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector. Use echo time from a block of known thickness as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

An oblique beam travels farther than the vertical depth. In this model, depth is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 77.7817 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Angle is measured inside the material from the normal; one straight one-way path is calculated. Use refracted angle and reflector location as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Treating sound path as depth mislocates the reflector; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Horizontal reflector position depends on beam direction and depth. In this model, depth is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 55 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Straight internal beam with planar geometry; probe orientation separately defines the offset sign. Use probe coordinate and refracted angle as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Wavelength affects scattering and resolution but is not the minimum guaranteed detectable crack size. In this model, c is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.4212 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Speed and frequency describe the same wave mode; dispersion and broadband effects are omitted. Use spectral centre and material wave speed as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Treating wavelength as a detection guarantee overstates capability; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Amplitude ratios are comparable only within a matched measurement chain. In this model, A is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to -13.1515 dB. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Amplitudes use the same receive chain with nonzero reference; amplitude rather than energy is compared. Use reference reflector and receiver gain as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Unrecorded gain changes mimic defect growth; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Under uniform attenuation the loss grows with path length. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.3 dB. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Attenuation coefficient is constant and path is the total traveled distance; geometric spreading is separate. Use reference reflectors at different distances as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring material differences can amplify noise excessively; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Pulse repetition frequency determines nominal along-scan spacing. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2.75 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Scan speed and effective pulse-acquisition rate are fixed; missed triggers and beam width are excluded. Use speed encoder and pulse timing as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Slip can leave an uninspected section; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Near-surface dead zone is a geometric extent, not defect probability. In this model, dead is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.66667 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Dead zone and total inspected extent share one direction; the fraction is not defect risk. Use near-surface artificial reflectors as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Unreported blind zones make uninspected regions appear accepted; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

Backwall echoes help monitor coupling but also depend on geometry and material. In this model, back is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.66 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Baseline and current echoes share geometry, gain and material; the ratio is not independent coupling truth. Use backwall echo and surface condition as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Coupling loss weakens defect and backwall echoes together; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

A blinded set with known truth is required to estimate sample miss fraction. In this model, misses is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 13.3333 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. All true-defect samples are included with fixed decision rules; no universal detection rate is inferred. Use blinded reflector inventory and test report as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Keeping only successful cases distorts performance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
evidence: 重算「垂直回波深度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出聲速均勻、垂直往返聲程且零時已扣除；反射體單一如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍造成偏離的合成觀察，以已知厚度試塊的回波時間說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
重算「斜入射聲程」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出角度在材料內相對法線定義；只計單程直線聲路如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把聲程直接當深度會錯定位造成偏離的合成觀察，以折射角與反射體位置說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
重算「水平定位偏距」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出材料內直線聲束與平面幾何；正負方向由探頭朝向另定如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側造成偏離的合成觀察，以探頭座標及折射角說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
重算「頻率波長換算」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出聲速與頻率屬同一波型；忽略色散與寬頻效應如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把波長當檢出保證會高估能力造成偏離的合成觀察，以頻譜中心與材料聲速說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
重算「聲幅分貝比較」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩幅值使用相同接收鏈且參考非零；比較振幅而非能量如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由改變增益卻未記錄會形成假缺陷變化造成偏離的合成觀察，以參考反射體與接收增益說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
evidenceEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Normal echo depth, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth. Explain which evidence in echo time from a block of known thickness distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Oblique sound path, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Angle is measured inside the material from the normal; one straight one-way path is calculated. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Treating sound path as depth mislocates the reflector. Explain which evidence in refracted angle and reflector location distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Horizontal reflector offset, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Straight internal beam with planar geometry; probe orientation separately defines the offset sign. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side. Explain which evidence in probe coordinate and refracted angle distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Frequency-wavelength conversion, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Speed and frequency describe the same wave mode; dispersion and broadband effects are omitted. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Treating wavelength as a detection guarantee overstates capability. Explain which evidence in spectral centre and material wave speed distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Echo-amplitude decibel comparison, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Amplitudes use the same receive chain with nonzero reference; amplitude rather than energy is compared. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Unrecorded gain changes mimic defect growth. Explain which evidence in reference reflector and receiver gain distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
pitfalls: 忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍。這個失效與「垂直回波深度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查已知厚度試塊的回波時間，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側。這個失效與「水平定位偏距」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查探頭座標及折射角，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
改變增益卻未記錄會形成假缺陷變化。這個失效與「聲幅分貝比較」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查參考反射體與接收增益，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
打滑會造成漏掃區段。這個失效與「掃描點距估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查速度編碼器與脈衝時序，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
耦合流失會使缺陷與背壁回波同時減弱。這個失效與「耦合訊號監測」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查背壁回波與表面狀況，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
pitfallsEn: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth. This failure and a measurement bias in Normal echo depth can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check echo time from a block of known thickness rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side. This failure and a measurement bias in Horizontal reflector offset can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check probe coordinate and refracted angle rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

Unrecorded gain changes mimic defect growth. This failure and a measurement bias in Echo-amplitude decibel comparison can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check reference reflector and receiver gain rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

Slip can leave an uninspected section. This failure and a measurement bias in Ultrasonic scan spacing can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check speed encoder and pulse timing rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

Coupling loss weakens defect and backwall echoes together. This failure and a measurement bias in Coupling signal ratio can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check backwall echo and surface condition rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 軌枕耐久與承載試驗
related.transfer: 可遷移「垂直回波深度」與「掃描點距估算」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；軌枕耐久與承載試驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Normal echo depth" and "Ultrasonic scan spacing" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sleeper durability and load testing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦聲程折射耦合盲區與缺陷證據；軌枕耐久與承載試驗則以軌枕彎曲預力疲勞與環境耐久為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「垂直回波深度」與「簡支跨中彎矩」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到軌枕耐久與承載試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「裂縫開口變化」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Normal echo depth” and “Simply supported midspan moment”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sleeper durability and load testing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Crack-opening change", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.title: 鋼軌超音波探傷
history.text: 本課把鋼軌超音波探傷放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。超音波探傷以聲束與缺陷交互作用取得間接證據，耦合、角度和鋼軌幾何會改變回波；沒有回波不能獨立證明沒有裂紋。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Ultrasonic rail-flaw detection in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Ultrasonic testing obtains indirect evidence from beam-defect interaction; coupling, angle and rail geometry alter echoes, so absence of an echo alone does not prove absence of a crack. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
